# Aunty Show Hair Braiding

> Hair braiding studio based in Austin, Texas. Knotless, boho, goddess and stitch braids on W Howard Lane in north Austin, from a braider with more than 20 years in the chair. Braiding hair is included, the parts are precise, and you are out faster than you expect.

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Lightweight knotless or classic box braids, any size and length, with clean, even parts.
- Boho & goddess braids: Braids with soft curls through the length, in natural black, honey, ombre or a color blend.
- Cornrows & stitch designs: Stitch braids, feed-ins and freestyle cornrow designs, from hearts and swirls to updos.
- Men's & kids' braids: Clean cornrow designs for the guys, and painless, fast, pretty styles for the kids.
- Twists, locs & micro braids: Senegalese and two-strand twists, faux locs, loc retwists and micro braids.
- Takedown, wash & blow-dry: Coming in with old braids? We can take them down, shampoo, condition and blow-dry first.

## About
Aunty Show Hair Braiding is Aunty Shola's shop at 1422 W Howard Lane in north Austin. She has been braiding for more than 20 years, and clients call her Aunty Shola, Aunt Show or just Shola. In her own words: "Hey it's Shola! I'm a braider out of Austin and I look forward to meeting and making you look your best!" People come back for the same reasons: neat, precise parts, braids that feel lightweight even at mid-back or waist length, and an install that is done faster than anywhere else they have been. Braiding hair is included in the price. Moms bring their daughters, coworkers send each other, and Aunty will happily take a call from the beauty supply store to make sure you are buying the right hair. As Shola puts it, we take our time and treat people the way we want to be treated: with respect.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call ahead if you are coming on a holiday or a Sunday.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Knotless, box and individual braids start at $190, Senegalese twists at $210, micro braids at $250 and faux locs at $260. Cornrows start at $50. The final price depends on size and length, and braiding hair is included.
- Q: Is braiding hair included?
  A: Yes. Braiding hair is included in the price. If you want human hair for curls, call us from the store and we will help you pick the right kind.
- Q: How long does an install take?
  A: It depends on size and length, but clients tell us they are often out of the chair in about 4 to 4.5 hours, even for long knotless braids.
- Q: Do you braid kids' and men's hair?
  A: Yes. Moms bring their daughters, and we do men's cornrows and designs too.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1422 W Howard Ln, Austin, TX 78728, in north Austin near Dessau Rd and Parmer Ln. There is plenty of parking.
